name: obsidian-claude-ghostty
description: Agent sidebar terminal for Obsidian — configurable startup commands + libghostty-vt renderer + node-pty + OSC 8 vault links

scripts.build:native: node scripts/build-ghostty-vt.mjs && node-gyp rebuild && cp build/Release/ghostty_vt.node native/ghostty_vt.node
scripts.build:native:electron: node scripts/build-ghostty-vt.mjs && node-gyp rebuild --runtime=electron --target=39.8.3 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && cp build/Release/ghostty_vt.node native/ghostty_vt.node
